mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.version, a.title, a.level, a.status, a.sender_name, a.recipient_count, a.publish_time, a.expire_time, a.create_time, a.error_message FROM t_sys_inbox_message a
(a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = #{form.status} AND a.level = #{form.level}
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id DESC ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM t_sys_inbox_message WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claimed_time < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY create_time, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize} ) UPDATE t_sys_inbox_message a SET status = 'PUBLISHING', claimed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, attempt_count = a.attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = a.version + 1 FROM candidates b WHERE a.id = b.id RETURNING a.*
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sys_inbox_message SET status = 'PUBLISHED', publish_time = #{publishTime}, recipient_count = #{recipientCount}, claimed_time = NULL, error_message = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'

UPDATE t_sys_inbox_message SET status = 'FAILED', claimed_time = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'
